info.description: Xident age and identity verification API. Server-side calls authenticate with an API key in the X-API-Key header.
info.title: Xident API

AccountToken.description: Xident ID account access token: the access_token that the account sign-in endpoints return, such as POST /verify/v1/accounts/login. Sent together with X-API-Key. Also accepted in the Authorization header with the AccountBearer scheme.
AccountToken.name: X-Account-Token

ApiKeyAuth.description: Your Xident API key: a secret key (sk_live_ or sk_test_) from your backend, an agent key (ak_live_ or ak_test_), or a public key (pk_live_ or pk_test_) where the endpoint allows one. It can also be sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>, except to GET /verify/v1/requirements/check and GET /verify/v1/events/{type}/{id}/stream, which read only the X-API-Key header.
ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key

BearerAuth.description: A credential in the Authorization header, as Bearer <token>. On every endpoint in this reference that takes an API key, Authorization: Bearer <your API key> works the same as X-API-Key, except GET /verify/v1/requirements/check and GET /verify/v1/events/{type}/{id}/stream, which do not read the Authorization header.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

OAuthBearerAuth.description: OAuth 2.0 access token from POST /oauth/token, sent as Authorization: Bearer <access_token>.
OAuthBearerAuth.name: Authorization

get.description: Returns user claims based on the scopes granted to the access token. Requires a valid OAuth access token. A missing, invalid or expired token is refused with 401 and the standard error envelope (code UNAUTHORIZED), not the RFC 6749 error body; a valid token whose subject is not an account is refused with 401 and the RFC 6749 body (error invalid_token). A rate limit refusal (429) uses the envelope.

The request body is the raw WebAuthn attestation and carries nothing else, so the session ID from register/begin travels in the X-Session-ID header. Creates a new liveness challenge with random actions the user must perform.

post.description: Submits the movement evidence for a previously issued challenge: the head pose trajectory (numbers only, no images). The server checks that the head turned in the issued order and completes the challenge. The result counts for a session only after PATCH /verify/v1/sessions/{id}/liveness attaches the challenge to it. A challenge can be answered once: a 200 answer uses it up, and so does a 400 INVALID_TRAJECTORY or DURATION_TOO_SHORT, so get a new challenge from GET /verify/v1/liveness/challenge before trying again. The frames field is accepted and ignored; do not send images. A request is refused with 400 INVALID_TRAJECTORY unless pose_trajectory has 20 to 2000 samples, each with t, yaw and pitch; t (in milliseconds) is not negative (any start value) and never decreasing; the samples cover at least 20 distinct t values; the last t minus the first is 1500 to 300000; and two samples with the same t have the same yaw and pitch. A value of the wrong JSON type, such as a t that is not a whole number or a yaw given as a string, is refused before the challenge is read, with 400 INVALID_REQUEST, and does not use up the challenge. A null t, yaw or pitch is not a type error: it is a refused trajectory, 400 INVALID_TRAJECTORY, and uses the challenge up.

get.description: Returns the verification verdict for a session, as the site owner's secret key sees it. `status` is a VERDICT, not a lifecycle marker: `success` means the user PASSED. A session that ran to the end of the flow but missed the age threshold is `failed`, with `reason` explaining why. Possible `status` values: `pending`, `in_progress`, `success`, `failed`, `canceled` (single L), `expired`, `pending_tenant_review`, `awaiting_retake`, `retaken`. Linking a portal account (Xident ID) to a passed verification does not change its status: it stays `success`. `external_user_id` echoes the `user_id` supplied at init so the session can be correlated to your own user server-side — do not correlate on the browser callback, which is unsigned. Requires a server-side credential: a secret key (`sk_live_` or `sk_test_`), an agent key (`ak_live_` or `ak_test_`), or an agent OAuth access token (`xat_`). An agent key or access token needs the `verification:read` scope. A public key gets 403 SECRET_KEY_REQUIRED. This is the ONE tenant-facing shape: identical regardless of caller, and mirrored verbatim into every webhook's `data` field.

parameters.description: Verification RESULT token (xtk_ prefixed) — NOT the xit_ init token
parameters.name: token

post.description: Submit a failed verification for human review. Requires document uploads.

patch.description: Stores client-side age estimation result on the verification session. The measurement fields (inference_run_id, model_sha, threshold_table_id, policy_version, align_id, widget_build, frames, threshold, outcome) are optional and never change the verdict. A measurement value of the wrong type or outside its documented limits is ignored: the request still succeeds and that value is not stored. A missing or ignored inference_run_id is replaced by an ID the server derives from the result, so a retransmission of the same result is stored once.
patch.summary: Update session with age estimation result

patch.description: Marks a session as completed or failed. Records usage event and dispatches webhook.

delete.description: Deletes all S3 files associated with a verification session (e.g., when user declines consent).

post.description: Issues a short-lived, single-use token for the desktop's QR code. The QR carries this token and nothing else — no api_key, no callback_url, no user_id. Tenant-scoped: a tenant can only mint for its own sessions.

patch.description: Stores liveness detection result on the verification session.

get.description: Widget calls this once per session to obtain the HMAC key used to sign capture-proof tokens at presign time.
get.summary: Issue or fetch a per-session HMAC key for capture-proof signing

post.description: Starts a new attempt linked to the given session: returns a new session token in the same retake chain, and the widget restarts capture against it. Refused with 409 RETAKE_NOT_ALLOWED when the session's status is success, canceled or retaken, or when it is a test session; every other status can be retaken. Refused with 409 RETAKE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED after 3 retakes in one chain.

get.description: Returns the widget-facing verdict for a session — no per-check detail, no age gate, no document/country data, and a masked failure reason. `status` uses the same public vocabulary as /verify/v1/result/{token}: `pending`, `in_progress`, `success`, `failed`, `canceled` (single L), `expired`, `pending_tenant_review`, `awaiting_retake`, `retaken`. Linking a portal account to a passed verification does not change its status: it stays `success`. This is the ONE subject-facing shape: it does not vary by which key type authenticated the request (public or secret both get it), because a credential-dependent response shape is exactly what this endpoint is designed NOT to have.

parameters.description: Verification RESULT token (xtk_ prefixed) — NOT the xit_ init token
parameters.name: token

Validates a verification token and returns whether it is valid, the age bracket, verification method, and expiration. Invalid, expired, or revoked tokens return valid=false without error. Requires API key auth.

Receives an mso_mdoc age attestation from a user's EU Digital Identity Wallet, checks its cryptographic proof against the EU Trusted List, and stores the result on the verification session. No camera or biometric data is involved.

align_id.description: face alignment version the frames went through

capture_luma.description: brightness (0 to 255) of the face crops the age model ran on; logged for diagnostics, never stored, no effect on the verdict

frames.description: frames the score is averaged over

gate.description: the age threshold, in years, that the widget checked the person against, for example 18

inference_run_id.description: one ID per inference run; a retransmission of the same run repeats it

model_sha.description: sha256 of the ONNX bytes the widget loaded

outcome.description: how the age model run ended

policy_version.description: version of the widget's rule for which age threshold to check for the session's minimum age

verified.description: the widget's own result for gate: true when it judged the person to be at least gate years old

widget_build.description: build of the verification widget that sent this result

expires_in.description: seconds until the key expires; request a new one after that

key.description: the HMAC key, base64url without padding; decode it to raw bytes before importing it (for example with WebCrypto importKey)

torch_schedule.description: the torch on/off pattern to follow while recording the optical capture

error.description: OAuth error code, such as invalid_request, invalid_client or invalid_grant

hidden.description: visibility events: whether the page was hidden

hidden_ms.description: visibility events: how long it was hidden, in milliseconds

mean.description: light events: mean pixel brightness of the camera frame

ms.description: latency events: how long it took, in milliseconds

reason.description: gyro_unavailable events: why the gyroscope could not be read

stage.description: latency events: which step was timed

ts_ms.description: gyro, light and visibility events: milliseconds since the session started

x.description: gyro events: device acceleration along x, in g, gravity included

y.description: gyro events: device acceleration along y, in g, gravity included

z.description: gyro events: device acceleration along z, in g, gravity included

schedule_frames.description: optional: frames recorded while following that schedule

schedule_id.description: optional: ID of the torch on/off schedule the widget followed (issued with the capture key)

api_key.description: the publishable key the phone uses for the rest of its calls

methods.description: the session's verification context, as GET /verify/v1/requirements/check returns it

expected_ref.description: opaque one-time reference to the identity data the site owner sent as expected; pass it as the expected_ref query parameter of GET /verify/v1/requirements/check, which links that data to the new session

verification_mode.description: "auto" (default), "document" (an ID document is always required) or "facial" (on-device checks only, never a document)

actions.description: optional map of action name to pass or fail, e.g. {"blink": true}; stored as sent, not checked

api_version.description: the dated API version this response was served under, on responses from operations that take X-API-Version, errors included; absent when the request is refused before its version is resolved: a missing or invalid API key (401), a failed API key lookup (500), a rate limit (429), a body whose declared Content-Length is over 10 MB (413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE) or an invalid X-API-Version (400 INVALID_API_VERSION)

pitch.description: required on every sample: head pitch as the Xident widget measures it; positive = looking up

t.description: required on every sample: milliseconds, a non-negative integer that never decreases; any start value is accepted

yaw.description: required on every sample: head yaw as the Xident widget measures it; positive = the person's own right

content_type.description: required for document_video (video/webm or video/mp4); ignored for photos

capture_proof_token.description: send the proof token from the capture step (the Xident widget sets it)

aml.description: sanctions and PEP (politically exposed person) screening of the identity read from the document; document path only; performed is false until screening is enabled

data_match.description: the identity data the site owner sent as `expected` at init, compared with the document; present only when `expected` was sent and a document was read

previous.description: original session's xtk_ token (for UI "retrying from..." display)

reason.description: a short failure reason for display, less detailed than the one the site owner sees

remaining_attempts.description: failed sessions started with a user_id only: the project's max_verification_attempts minus the retakes before this session in its retake chain, at least 0; informational, the server allows at most 3 retakes per chain and a new session starts a new chain

status.description: the same verdict values as the status of GET /verify/v1/result/{token}

test.description: true when the verdict came from a test-mode session; absent on live sessions

ip_country.description: country the end user connected from, from their IP address when the session started; not the document's issuing country (checks.document.country)

risk.description: coarse fraud risk band: low, elevated or high; omitted when no document checks ran, which is not the same as low

status.description: the verdict, the same for every verification path: pending, in_progress, success, failed, canceled (one L), expired, pending_tenant_review, awaiting_retake or retaken; linking a Xident ID account never changes it, and a passed verification stays success

test.description: true when the verdict came from a test-mode session (a test API key), never a real verification; treat it as granting nothing; absent on live sessions

verification_type.description: which path produced the verdict: full (document and face match), age_check (in the browser: liveness and/or age, no document), xident_id (a returning user reused an age already proven on their Xident ID) or eu_wallet (EU Digital Identity Wallet); named verification_mode before 2026-08-13; checks says exactly which checks ran

verified.description: the one value to base access control on; set by the server from status, never taken from a client

keyframes.description: optional: a few frames of the same sequence at the camera's full resolution

flips_ms.description: when to switch the torch, in milliseconds from the start of the capture, ascending

id.description: send it back as schedule_id with the capture

window_ms.description: how long to keep recording, in milliseconds

action_results.description: Legacy; accepted but ignored since 2026-09-25 (not movement evidence)

frames.description: accepted and ignored; do not send images

light_metrics.description: Light check results reported by the widget.

pose_trajectory.description: required: 20 to 2000 head pose samples, the only movement evidence; the rules are in the description of POST /verify/v1/liveness/verify

capture_proof_token.description: send the proof token from the capture step (the Xident widget sets it)

document_video_guide.description: optional: where the document sat in the document video's frame, as fractions of the frame width and height (0 to 1)

email.description: the address the account was registered with

bracket.description: the age bracket the account had already proven

expected.description: the identity data you already hold about the user; Xident compares it with the document and reports match, mismatch or not_on_document per field, and the values never come back; needs a document (purpose id_verification or verification_mode document)

mismatch_policy.description: "report" (default) records the outcome only; "review" sends the session to your review queue on any mismatch

verification_mode.description: "auto" (default), "document" (an ID document and a face match are always required, no on-device age estimation) or "facial" (on-device only, never a document); unlike purpose id_verification, it keeps min_age

outcome.description: what the widget showed at the end: success or failed

XApiVersion.name: X-API-Version
XApiVersion.description: Dated API version, e.g. 2026-08-13. Overrides the version pinned to the API key for this request only; omit it to use the pin. The response echoes the version it was served under in this same header and in meta.api_version, except when the request is refused before its version is resolved: a missing or invalid API key (401), a failed API key lookup (500), a rate limit (429), a body whose declared Content-Length is over 10 MB (413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE) or an invalid X-API-Version (400 INVALID_API_VERSION). See https://docs.xident.io/api-versioning
